name: milliQan
summary: milliQan is a dedicated low-ionization-signal experiment in underground tunnels near CMS at CERN LHC Point 5. Millicharge is a dark-sector clue, rather than automatically all of cosmic dark matter.
detection_principle: Coincidences in multiple layers of long plastic-scintillator bars detect extremely small ionization; single-photoelectron readout and timing/directional correlations suppress dark counts and cosmic rays.

results.summary: Initial Run 3 results constrain millicharged particles, without a discovery claim.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
